MINI-MINUTES FOR MAR-28-2006 10:30 AM FOR DEPT 612

DISCOVERY 612, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER RESPONSES TO SPECIAL INTERROGATORIES, REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS, REQUEST FOR ADMISSIONS, AND FORM INTERROGATORIES; REQUEST FOR ORDER COMPELLING VERICATIONS TO DISCOVERY IS MOOT IN PART AND GRANTED IN PART. AS TO FORM INTERROGATORIES NOS. 16.1, 16.2, 16.3, 16.4, 16.5, 16.6, AND 17.1, THE OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED. DEFENDANTS ARE ORDERED TO RESPOND FURTHER AS THE RESPONSES ARE INCOMPLETE. AS TO REQUESTS FOR ADMISSIONS 1 AND 4, THE OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED. DEFENDANTS ARE ORDERED TO RESPOND FURTHER, ALTHOUGH THE RESPONSE THAT DEFENDANTS ARE UNABLE TO ADMIT OR DENY MAY BE ADEQUATE. THE RESPONSES MUST BE MADE UPON A DECLARATION THAT DEFENDANTS HAVE MADE REASONABLE INQUIRY AS REQUIRED BY C.C.P. SECTION 2033.220. A RESPONSE WHICH RESERVES A RIGHT TO AMEND IS NOT ADEQUATE. AS TO THE REQUEST FOR PRODUCTION NOS. 1-6, THE OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED. DEFENDANTS ARE ORDERED TO RESPOND FURTHER AS THE RESPONSES ARE INADEQUATE AND THERE IS NO PRIVILEGE LOG OR STATEMENT THAT NO DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN WITHHELD PURSUANT TO A CLAIM OF PRIVILEGE. VERIFICATIONS AND FURTHER RESPONSES SHALL BE MADE WITHIN 15 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ALL REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
MINI-MINUTES FOR MAR-28-2006 10:30 AM FOR DEPT 612

DISCOVERY 612, DEFENDANTS' MOTION TO COMPEL PLAINTIFF'S DEPOSITION, FOR TERMINATING AND MONETARY SANCTIONS; AND FOR A PROTECTIVE ORDER IS MOOT AS PLAINTIFF HAS APPEARED FOR DEPOSITION. COUNSEL SHALL MEET AND CONFER TO SCHEDULE THE CONTINUATION OF THE DEPOSITION CONSISTENT WITH PLAINTIFF'S MEDICAL CONDITION, BUT NO LATER THAN APRIL 7, 2006. THE COURT WILL NOT MAKE ANY ORDERS REGARDING DEPOSITION QUESTIONS ON THIS MOTION. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS IT SEEKS AN ORDER RELIEVING DEFENDANTS FROM RESPONDING TO DISCOVERY UNTIL AFTER THE COMPLETION OF THE DEPOSITION. ALL REQUESTS FOR MONETARY SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
